name: Departure
tagline: A split-flap departures board: every step a flight, every status a flap.
mood: The hush of an airport departures hall before dawn: a black board of off-white flaps, fixed columns, one lit cell where something is boarding, a soft clatter when a word turns, and nothing else moving.
rationale: A departures board is already the right shape for this tool: a grid read in a glance a hundred times a day, where the columns never move and only the words change. It answers the spacing complaint directly: every row sits on one grid (flap cell at col 1, STEP at col 3, TITLE at 9, STATUS at 45, AGENT at 55, TIME right-aligned to 70), every section opens with a label after exactly one blank line, and the right column is aligned across rows and sections. Its character is what a board does not have: no dots, no ticks, no markers beside the titles. Status is a word in the STATUS column (ON TIME, BOARDING, DEPARTED, DELAYED), and col 1 is a lamp column of flap cells that stays dark except where something is live or waiting: one off-white cell on the boarding row, a lit `?` where a decision waits, a lit `!` where something is delayed. So the eye finds the one lit cell first and reads the word second. The palette is a Solari board's: off-white flaps on the terminal's own black (on paper the board inverts to a dark flap), colour only where it means something (success, warning, error on the theme keys), and one warm band under the boarding row. The board's uppercase is its own vocabulary only; the person's words (titles, phase names, questions, shas, tool names) are drawn exactly as written, and the only motion is one flap turning on one row when the board changes.
tokenMap: bg: none (the terminal's own background; the pane never paints a full background; the hex is only what the mock renders). fg: the `text` theme key, unconditionally, for every untagged run and for the bold runs (titles, questions, shas, values, section labels, BOARDING); the mock's #e8e2d4 / #2a2318 is only its rendering. dim: `dimColor`, never a hex. accent is the flap face and has two jobs only: the Text backgroundColor of a lit flap cell (the boarding row's col-1 cell, written `{inverse}` in the mock, which the page renders as an fg-coloured tile, i.e. the same off-white) and the turned cells `▮` of the meter (Text color): #efe6cf on dark themes (Solari off-white), #2b261d on light (on paper the board inverts: a dark flap). accent2 is the flap's ink, the color of any glyph standing on a lit flap (`?`, `!`): #15120d dark / #f7f0de light; it never appears off a flap. bg2 is the one warm note: the boarding row's band (Box backgroundColor across the 70 content cells) and the hover band of any row: #22190a dark / #f0e6cf light. success/warning/error are always the theme keys (their hex above is only the mock's rendering), and colour on this board appears only where it means something: the done phase chip and the gate in success; `?`, D1, WAITING and `~` in warning; health `!`, DELAYED and `✗` in error. A lit semantic flap (`?` WAITING, `!` DELAYED) is Text backgroundColor="warning"|"error" with color accent2; the mock writes it `{warning}{inverse}`, which the page can only render as an off-white tile. `~` NOTICED is never lit: a plain warning glyph. The scheme switch is `$.config.list()`'s `theme` row (`light`, `light-daltonized`, `light-ansi` -> light set; `dark*` -> dark set), refreshed on config.set; when the row is missing, the boarding flap falls back to Text `inverse` (the person's own text colour as the face, which is the same idea), semantic flaps become plain bold warning/error glyphs as today, the meter `▮` is plain `text` and bg2 is dropped, so detection failure degrades to a plain readable board. Footer: the engine draws `1:` prefixes in its own colour (mocked `{claude}`); the active tab is a bold Text inside its Button, no block, so focus stays visible.

otherTabs: Plan is the full board: every phase a header row on the same grid (`A API`, `B UI`, `C Docs` in their tone, success / bold / dim, with n/n in the TIME column and no marks), folded phases showing only their header, open ones listing their rows with the same flap column and STATUS words. Log reads like the board's announcements: a dim HH:MM in the STEP column, the line as written in TITLE, Rulings with a dark flap holding `R` in warning (never lit: nothing waits on it) and the line in warning. Step details put the step's own board row on top (flap, id, title as written, status word, agent, time), then the grid's label width (STATUS, NOTE, COMMIT, GATE, AGENTS, DRIFT, ASKS as 6-cell dim captions at the STEP column) with values in the TITLE column. Needs you lists each question as a board row with its lit `?` flap, the question in TITLE, WAITING in the STATUS column and `blocks B4` in AGENT, then the why line, then the option Buttons (the recommended one `variant="primary"`, the engine's own emphasis; none inverse); answered ones go dark and read DEPARTED under a dim ANSWERED caption.
glyphs: No status glyphs: a board has words and lamps, not dots. Every row's col 1 is a flap cell, one cell wide: lit with the accent face (an off-white tile, empty) when the row is BOARDING; lit in warning holding `?` (ink accent2) when a decision is WAITING; lit in error holding `!` when a step or blocker is DELAYED; dark (a plain space) for DEPARTED, ON TIME and CANCELED. Drift `~` NOTICED is a dark flap: the warning glyph alone, so `?` and `~` read as different weights on the band and in NEEDS YOU. STATUS words carry everything else: todo ON TIME (dim) · doing BOARDING (bold; the current step adds the bg2 band, another doing step keeps its lit flap without the band) · done DEPARTED (dim, title dim) · blocked DELAYED (error, lit flap) · skipped CANCELED (dim, title strikethrough). Phase chips are letters, names and counts in their tone, no marks: `A API 5/5` success (done), `B UI 2/6` bold (current), `C Docs 0/7` dim (todo); they fold to `A  B  C` in the same tones when the tail would come within 2 cells of the PLAN label. Health, the first cell of the band and of the header, keeps the mod's shared marks, unlit: `▶` working (success), `!` needs you (error), `✗` gate red (error), `✓` finished (success). Meter: `▮` turned flap (accent) and `▯` blank flap (dim), U+25AE/U+25AF, East-Asian-width neutral; 10 cells on the band, 20 in the header (the current code's widths). The flip frames use `▀` and `▄` (block elements). Uppercase is the board's voice and applies only to its own vocabulary: STATUS words, the caption row, section labels, the footer tabs, and the captions GATE / GIT / CTX / AGENTS (so the band reads `2 AGENTS`, `GATE ✓ 4m`). Everything the person or the engine wrote is drawn as written: the run title, phase names (`Docs`), step titles, questions, drift and log lines, branch, shas, model and tool names (the AGENT cell is `opus Edit`, `sonnet`). Finished: every row DEPARTED, every flap dark, meter all `▮`, health `✓`, band elapsed reads `took 3h12m`; with nothing asked the NEEDS tail reads `1 NOTICED` and the band carries no `? n`. Empty (0 steps): `NO DEPARTURES` dim on the first row under the caption. All glyphs are width-1 BMP; `▶` is East-Asian-ambiguous exactly as in the current code.
spacingRules: The pane keeps paddingX={1} and lays its 70 content cells on one grid: col 1 flap cell (1), col 3 STEP (4), col 9 TITLE (34, flexGrow), col 45 STATUS (8), col 55 AGENT (9), TIME (5) right-aligned ending at col 70; column gaps are exactly 2 cells (1 after the flap). The flap column is a lamp column: empty on every row except where something is live or waiting, so the STEP column is where every row's text visibly starts and the one lit cell stands alone at the left edge. Two hanging positions only: section labels and the footer hang at col 1; all content starts at STEP (col 3): the branch line, the caption row, the SIGNALS labels (GATE / GIT / CTX, 4 cells like STEP, values in the TITLE column, the second group's label at col 45 and its value at col 51). Section rhythm: one blank line before every section label, none inside a section; the label line carries its tail flush right (counts, phase chips folding to `A  B  C` when the tail would come within 2 cells of the label); the dim caption row sits under PLAN only. NEEDS rows deliberately keep three columns: flap + id, text spanning TITLE through STATUS (46 cells, so the drift line fits verbatim), then AGENT and TIME on the grid; the drift line never runs into the TIME column. The current row is the only bg2 band at rest: it opens at the flap cell (lit, at the band's left edge) and spans exactly the 70 content cells. Hover and focus: every row is a keyed Box with `hover={{ backgroundColor: bg2 }}`, so pointing at a flight lays the band under it (the board's cursor) and the engine's own invert marks the focused Button; that is how the person learns rows press. Narrowing: TITLE flexes down to 20 cells, then AGENT drops (under 56 content cells), then STATUS drops (under 45) and the flap column plus the dim done titles carry the state alone. Never adjacent: two lit cells (the flap column holds at most one per row and a Button always sits a cell away from a flap), a status word and an agent name (the 2-cell gap), a section tail and the next section's label (the blank line). Footer: tabs separated by 2 cells, the active tab bold, the engine's `1:` prefixes in its own colour.
desktopNotes: Spaces do not hold in a proportional font, so the grid becomes Boxes: each row is the flap `Box width={1} minWidth={1}` (backgroundColor when lit, holding the `?` / `!` Text or nothing; a Box rather than a blank Text, because a lit space in a proportional font is a sliver), the STEP+TITLE Button, a flexGrow spacer and a right group of three `Box width={8|9|5}` each wrapping a Text (STATUS, AGENT, TIME) with gap 2 (TextProps has no width; the Box carries it); the dim caption row is dropped there (the words explain themselves). The bg2 band and the hover band survive (Box backgroundColor and BoxHoverProps.backgroundColor), the meter stays a run of ▮▯ glyphs (no rule rows anywhere, so nothing wraps). Section labels stay the bold uppercase word with a marginTop of 1, which is the current non-mono behaviour. The flip is a terminal treat: on desktop (Client is allowed there, but the pane keeps the plain word), mobile and VS Code the word and the flap simply change on the redraw. In VS Code the band is not drawn; the pane is the same board. On the phone, STATUS and TIME stay in the right group, AGENT drops under 40 cells, and the flap column still says what is live.

animation.idea: The split-flap flip, once per event, on one row: when the board's current row changes status, its 8-cell STATUS word turns through two edge-on frames to the new word, like one flap turning on a real board. Nothing else ever moves: the gate result, a new question and every other row's word simply appear.
animation.trigger: A step becoming current (ON TIME -> BOARDING; its flap lights with the same redraw) or, when the run finishes, the last step departing (BOARDING -> DEPARTED; its flap goes dark and every flap on the board is now dark: the finished moment, one shot, then rest). The step that departs as the next one boards lands on DEPARTED without a flip, so there is never more than one flip on screen. The hooks module keeps a lastStatus map per step (stamped where startedAt/doneAt already are) and passes `{ from, to, changedAt, quiet, tone }` to the Client on that one row only, so the freshly mounted instance knows the word to flip from; it flips only when `from` differs from `to` and `changedAt` is within the last 2 s. Skipped (the new word appears directly) while the person is typing (a prompt.edit hook marks typing until 1.5 s after the last edit and sets `quiet`), on desktop, mobile and VS Code, and on the band, which only ever shows the static word.
animation.cadence: One shot: 4 frames at 170 ms (old word -> ▀▀▀▀▀▀▀▀ -> ▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄ -> new word), ~6 fps for 0.7 s, then the Client's every() is cleared; idle cost zero.
animation.staticFrame: The status word itself in its tone (bold BOARDING on the bg2 band beside the lit flap, dim DEPARTED and ON TIME, error DELAYED): the frame the pane shows at every other moment, identical to the plain Text the other rows use.

feasibility: Checked against the engine's type declarations (plugins/cache/claude-kit/progress-pane/0.2.0/.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts): Box has width, minWidth and backgroundColor, so the flap cell is a 1-wide Box that keeps its width on proportional surfaces; TextProps has color and backgroundColor, so a lit `?` / `!` is one Text on that Box with color accent2; BoxHoverProps carries backgroundColor, so the hover band needs only a keyed row Box and runs no hook; Buttons are inverted by the engine under focus and pointer, which is why a flap never touches a Button. ClientProps has width, height and flexGrow, so an 8x1 Client sits inline in the row in place of the STATUS Text; ClientSurface.every() is started once while state is undefined and returns its clearer; the old word arrives as the `from` prop, so a Client mounted at the moment of change has its first frame. prompt.edit is a real hook, so typing can be known. A Button with a hotkey is drawn as `1: ` in the engine's colour then the label (confirmed), so the footer mock shows that prefix as `{claude}`; the active tab is a bold Text inside the Button. The light answer depends on $.config.list() exposing the theme row (its example does); when absent, the boarding flap is Text inverse, semantic flaps are plain bold glyphs, the meter is plain text and bg2 is dropped, so the board stays a plain readable grid. ▮▯ are U+25AE/25AF and ▀▄ U+2580/2584 (BMP, width 1); if a font draws ▮▯ oddly the fallback is █░ at the same widths. `bg2` is Box backgroundColor on the row Box inside paddingX={1}, hence 70 cells, not 72. Uppercase is a presentation transform applied to the board's own vocabulary only. Nothing here needs Raster, Image or Svg.
implementationNotes:
- view.tsx: replace the status GLYPH map with a STATUS vocabulary map (`todo: 'ON TIME', doing: 'BOARDING', done: 'DEPARTED', blocked: 'DELAYED', skipped: 'CANCELED'`) and a `flapOf(step, kind)` helper returning `{ face: 'accent' | 'warning' | 'error' | null, char: '' | '?' | '!' }` (lit for doing, a waiting decision, blocked; null otherwise); keep TONE for semantics; add a `caption()` helper that uppercases only the board's own vocabulary, and a `columns`-aware grid (`flap 1 · STEP 4 · TITLE flex (min 20) · STATUS 8 · AGENT 9 · TIME 5`, gaps 2, 1 after the flap) used by stepRow, the caption row, needs rows and the step-details header. stepRow becomes a keyed Box (`hover={{ backgroundColor: bg2 }}`) holding the flap Box + a STEP+TITLE Button + spacer + three `Box width` cells, with `backgroundColor` bg2 on `currentStepOf(doc)`; no status glyph and no `▸` anywhere; lettering stays on `text`, done rows dimColor, the current row bold. AGENT and then STATUS drop by the content width (56 / 45).
- stepRow: show the linked agent (model and tool as written, age in TIME) on a todo step too (B5 sonnet 1m); `agentOf` already links it; lastTool stays only on doing rows.
- planChips: letters, names and counts in their tone (success done, bold current, dim todo), no marks, folding to bare letters when `ruleParts`-style room runs out; phase names drawn as written.
- bandSegments: keep the step title as written, add a `status` segment (`  BOARDING`, bold) with drop 8 and extend the drop loop to `[8,7,6,5,4,3]`, so the status word goes first: at 60 columns the band reads `! 7/18 B3 Seat limit checks  2 AGENTS  GATE ✓ 4m   ? 1  ~ 1` (59 cells) with no BOARDING, as band60 shows; drop the leading space of the step segment. Right counts: `?` is a Text holding the glyph alone with backgroundColor warning and color accent2, `~` a plain warning Text (never lit), each followed by a space and its bold count Button; today the padding spaces sit inside the glyph Text (`? ` on the band, ` ? ` in needsBlock) and would paint a 2-3 cell flap, so they move to their own Text. Note: README says segments drop bar -> git -> agents -> gate, but the code drops elapsed (7) first; with status at 8 the order is status -> elapsed -> bar -> git -> agents -> gate, and the README should be corrected.
- Palette: a `tone` table read once per draw from a `theme` atom the hooks module fills from `$.config.list()` and refreshes on config.set (`light*` -> light hex set, else dark; missing -> boarding flap Text inverse, plain semantic glyphs, no bg2); lettering stays on `text`, dim on dimColor, success/warning/error on the theme keys; the only hex is the flap face and ink and the band.
- Animation: new surface module `hooks/flap.tsx` (default export draws 8 cells from `{ from, to, changedAt, quiet, tone }`; when `from !== to` and not quiet, runs 4 frames via every(170) then clears, else draws `to`); the hooks module keeps `lastStatus: Record<stepId, Step['status']>` next to startedAt/doneAt and names the one row that flips (the step that became current, or the last step on finish); view.tsx places `<Client key={`flap-${step.id}`} module="./flap.tsx" width={8} .../>` only on the terminal and only on that row while its change is under 2 s old, plain Text otherwise (register.tsx already redraws every 5 s, so the swap back is free); a `prompt.edit` hook in register.tsx stamps the typing time that sets `quiet`.
- Footer and sections: section rules replaced by the bold uppercase label with a right tail (chips, `1 WAITING · 1 NOTICED`) and a blank line above; a dim caption row under PLAN in mono only; the active tab label becomes a bold Text inside its Button (no inverse, no brackets); tests in view.test.tsx updated for the flap column (lit only for doing / waiting / blocked), the dotless chips, the new band segments, the drop order and the grid widths.
